data.name: Sydskånes avfallsaktiebolag (SYSAV)
data.description: Sysav (Sydskånes avfallsaktiebolag) is a waste management utility owned by 14 municipalities in southern Skåne, Sweden, handling collection, recycling, and waste-to-energy incineration. Through its SkyZero project, the company plans to install CCS at its Malmö waste-to-energy plant by 2030, capturing up to 400,000 tonnes CO2/yr with the biogenic fraction giving negative emissions. Waste management remains its core business; CDR is an adjacent activity.
